messages.author: ea1b1ee8c5612c45
messages.subject: Using paste inside summarise()
parts:
I'm hoping someone here can help me. I've got a data frame (products) with two columns, PRODUCT and MASTER_DATA_SET. I want to find all the duplicate PRODUCT's and see the MASTER_DATA_SET's they are in. So I tried this:

duplicates <- products %.%
   group_by(PRODUCT) %.%
   summarise(count=n(), mds=paste(MASTER_DATA_SET, sep=":")) %.%
   filter(count > 1)

which didn't quite work like I thought it would. The mds column in the resulting data just has one of the strings in it when I was hoping it would paste together the strings. Is there a way to do this which I'm missing?

Thanks,

Dave

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Using paste inside summarise()
